description: Apply the user's own fuel surcharge schedule to the EIA (DOE) weekly retail on-highway diesel index and return the surcharge for the latest EIA week plus a weekly table. Two methods: percent (completed increments above the base price times the percentage per increment; needs increment and percent_per_increment) and per_mile ((diesel - base) / mpg in USD per mile; needs mpg). Regions are the U.S. average, the EIA PADD regions and California. Use when a shipper or carrier asks what their surcharge is this week under their own schedule; opa_get_fuel_surcharge returns carrier-published rates instead. The answer states when the API marks the index stale. Requires an API key; the API applies no plan gate to this endpoint.

base_price.description: Diesel price (USD/gallon) already built into the base rate, e.g. 1.25.

increment.description: Required for percent: diesel step (USD/gallon) per surcharge step, at least 0.001, e.g. 0.05.

mpg.description: Required for per_mile: fleet fuel economy in miles per gallon, at least 1.

percent_per_increment.description: Required for percent: surcharge percentage points added per step, e.g. 1.

region.description: EIA diesel region (default: national, the U.S. average).

rounding.description: percent only: floor (default, completed steps), ceil (a partial step counts) or exact (no banding).

weeks.description: Recent EIA weeks in the table, 1 to 52 (default: 4).

name: opa_calculate_fuel_surcharge
title: Calculate Fuel Surcharge
